text: かったら　はやく　あっち　いって！

structure.jp: はやく　あっち　いって！
structure.en: hurry up and go over there!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'once' that thing has happened. かったら = 'once you've won'.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: The て-form alone is a casual request, with ください left off. いって = 'go'.
